entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, and I apologize for the wait time. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? The issue is they're garbage! They gave me horrible blisters on my first long ride. The fit is all wrong, and I can't get the cleats adjusted properly. I spent a fortune on these and I expect better. I want a refund, and I want it now.

That sounds incredibly painful and frustrating, and I certainly understand why you'd want to return them. Getting blisters from new shoes is the last thing anyone wants. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
It's Michael Chen, order number 77-8-1-5-9. Don't try to give me the runaround. If I don't get a full refund, I'm taking this to social media and every cycling forum I'm on. You'll regret it.

Thank you, Michael. I've got your order right here. I see you purchased the VeloPro cycling shoes about 39 days ago. And I just want to say, I appreciate your business with us; I see you're one of our VIP members. I can absolutely process this return for you. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days, so you're well within that timeframe.
Well, of course I'm within the timeframe. So what's the next step? Are you going to make me pay to ship this junk back?

Not at all. As a valued VIP customer, and given the trouble you've had, I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You can just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. There will be no cost to you. The moment the return is scanned by the carrier, we will issue the full refund to your original payment method.
A pre-paid label. Fine. That's the least you could do.

I agree. And to further apologize for the negative experience, especially with the painful blisters, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. You can use that on any future purchase with us. We hope we get a chance to make this right for you.
Oh. A credit? Okay. Well... that's... acceptable. Fine. A pre-paid label and a credit. Just make sure that refund is processed quickly once I ship the shoes.
I will personally monitor it to ensure it's processed without delay. You should have that email with the label in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Michael?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
